summary: Iteration 115 - Category-level assignment expansion verified end-to-end. All 6 backend tests passed against public URL. Category='Water' with no subcategory expands to 4 independent leaf assignments (Withdrawal, Discharge, Consumption, Recycle); no parent assignment (subcategory=null) is stored; each leaf has assignment_source='category' and expanded_from_category='Water'; direct subcategory assignment gets assignment_source='subcategory'; GET /api/esg-assignments/progress/category/{category} aggregates progress across expanded subcategory assignments; re-submitting the category-level assignment updates all subcategory rows (bulk-by-category update behavior).

minor.issue: Return payload wraps a summary dict under key 'assignment' whose id is null; frontends written to expect a single assignment object may need to inspect 'expansion_type' to detect expansion. Not a bug per design, but worth documenting.

critical_code_review_comments: assignment_service_v2._get_subcategories_for_category: is_active filter uses {'$ne': False}, which is correct, but the docstring should note the fallback to environment_records uses field 'org_id' while assignments store 'organization_id' - keep this discrepancy in mind if the collection schema is unified.

Category expansion return shape is a summary dict, not an Assignment; the /api/esg-records/assignments endpoint returns it under key 'assignment' which is semantically misleading. Consider returning under 'expansion_summary' for clarity in a future revision.

In _expand_category_to_subcategories, sub_subcategory sourced from esg_record_categories may be empty string ('') and is normalized to None only in the else branch of a truthy check; empty strings become None which is fine, but be aware if downstream code stores '' anywhere.
seed_data_creation: Assignments created and torn down in TEST_2024_ITER115 and TEST_direct_* reporting periods; teardown fixture cleans up.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Category expansion endpoint: POST /api/esg-records/assignments with {category, reporting_period, assignment_level, user_ids} and NO subcategory triggers expansion. The Water category has 4 subcategories (Withdrawal, Discharge, Consumption, Recycle) seeded in esg_record_categories. Leaf assignments carry assignment_source='category' and expanded_from_category='Water'. Progress aggregation endpoint: GET /api/esg-assignments/progress/category/{category}. Tests file: /app/backend/tests/test_category_expansion_iter115.py.
rca of the issue: N/A - no issues found; feature works as specified.
